profile_paragraphs: UACh’s Facultad de Medicina was created on 5 October 1959. Its Escuela de Medicina was created in 1967. The faculty is based at Campus Isla Teja in Valdivia, with its biomedical-sciences building used by the Medicine school.

The current dean is Dr. Pamela Ehrenfeld (full name Ingrid Pamela Ehrenfeld Slater). For postgraduate academic contact, the university lists Escuela de Graduados de Medicina at graduadosmedicina@uach.cl and +56 63 2221410.

Hospital Base Valdivia is the faculty’s principal teaching field. UACh reports a longstanding teaching-care alliance with the hospital, and the hospital’s 2026 bulletin identifies a Policlínico de Reumatología. This is a concrete local clinical rheumatology contact point.

UACh has an international-relations unit and student-mobility office, but the reviewed official pages did not establish English-medium medicine teaching. Its academic-vacancy workflow routes applicants through an internal Recruiting “Puestos actuales” view that could not be publicly read.
